origin: Reading of the 15 published Orlagau transcripts on 2026-10-21 by five model readers with one rubric (scores 1-10), and the user's listening note of 2026-10-23. The model scores are one reading, not a measured listener test.
listener_note: Heard episodes 1 to 4 and fell asleep; only the beginning of episode 2 was quite good; none was really good.

ep_001.missed: Ezzo's revolt and reconciliation, Richeza's marriage to Mieszko, told late and buried under qualifications.

ep_002.missed: Kuchavez's warriors at the Lechfeld, accused of plundering the dead duke, losing the judicial duel and hanged; in the dossier only as a one-sentence illustration from Billig's paraphrase of Thietmar.

ep_003.missed: Richeza's life: queen of Poland, driven out with her son, her last years in Saalfeld, the dispute over her body.

ep_004.missed: The Brauweiler forgers of 1255-1272, disguised hands and imperial charters made against the monastery's own advocates.

ep_009.missed: Adolf of Altena crowning two rival kings, banned and deposed; Saalfeld as his reward.

ep_014.missed: Heinrich IV of Weida: divorced before the bishop at Mildenfurth, Jutta becomes prioress at Cronschwitz, he joins the Order, fights the Prussians and offers Lübeck a town at the Pregel mouth.
